status: ONE bounded proposal, saved after exploratory cloud results; not executed and no automatic launch scheduled
purpose: Test finite-strength odd/even scaling and predict a held-out intervention strength in full coordinates. This does not estimate a full Jacobian or prove manifold curvature.
direction: The same fixed unit v only; no direction, layer, rank or model search
native_delivery: Exactly h + signed_alpha*v_native_BF16, persistently at every nonpadding prefill/decode position. No coefficient grid, adaptive norm matching or post-result strength adjustment. Record each actual delivered1024-vector, its projection onto unit native v, norm, orthogonal rounding component and +/- site parity. This exact-coefficient -0.5 differs slightly from the older norm-matched minus control; do not pool them.
system: You are an assistant. Give concise public explanations. Do not use tools or hidden reasoning. Follow the requested format.
positions: First8 prediction positions, including final prefill; primary full8-position score, with prefill/decode sensitivities retained

prompts.text: A museum volunteer sorts six ticket stubs by their printed dates. Explain how to check the ordering in ordinary language.
A gardener marks three pots before comparing their watering schedules. Explain how to record equal starting conditions.
A cyclist compares two routes on a printed map. Explain how to count the turns on each route before choosing one.

cache_policy: Fresh native generate/cache for every condition, identical prefix and forced history within a context. Do not reuse a perturbed cache across conditions.

analysis.parity: Per context/position, odd_alpha=(delta_plus-delta_minus)/2 and even_alpha=(delta_plus+delta_minus)/2. Compute the same quantities at injection. Report actual-update-normalized norms and both adjacent log-log slopes without selecting a favorable level or token window.
analysis.fit: Only +/-0.125 and +/-0.25 fit two full-coordinate directional coefficients L,C for delta(beta)=beta*L+beta^2*C, separately per context/prediction position; beta is the signed projection of the actual native update onto native unit v. Also fit the nested linear-only model. No generator training, classifier training, dimension/rank/regularization search or high-strength access during fitting.
analysis.held_out: Freeze fitted low-strength coefficients before scoring +/-0.5. Predict actual full-coordinate displacement and score against zero displacement, retaining every sign/context failure. This tests unseen strength within calibrated contexts, not unseen-context generalization.
analysis.support_rule: Quadratic forecast must beat the linear-only forecast and zero-displacement baseline for both held-out signs in all three contexts. Otherwise no supported useful quadratic forecast. Scaling exponents are diagnostics, not a replacement success rule.
analysis.quantization_limits: Use actual site beta and parity to expose scalar rounding effects. Unknown propagation of off-direction BF16 rounding and persistent recurrent/KV history remains a competing explanation; no intrinsic curvature or local-Jacobian claim follows even on success.
analysis.precision_controls: Before interpreting results, validate the fixed low-strength forecasting procedure on pure known linear/quadratic full-vector transforms with final BF16 recording. Final recording controls do not isolate full-network quantization.

native_gates: Pinned source/model/vector hashes, frozen eval generator, exact untreated/null logits, exact upstream and pre-injection equality, nonzero finite actual updates; preserve all faults/missing cases with no scientific retries or convenient case dropping

forecast.before_execution: Fresh credits/rate/session admission and live export-path verification in the actual owned runtime. Count setup failures toward that study cap, reserve5minutes for exports, use process-bound worker/hard timers. No purchases/cap increases/duplicate workers/automatic auth or inference retry loops; do not operate R3 or reset any working user mount.

boundary: No execution in the current CPU geometry follow-up. Preserve classifier results, failed original gate, stopped temporal-rotation result, older queues and fresh eight-question geometry reserve. This proposal does not authorize a broad sweep.
